description: Find Rudolf Steiner's books, lectures and free audio recordings by topic, title, GA (Collected Works) number or year. Returns links to read them on rsarchive.org, listen on rudolfsteineraudio.com, buy them, and the Sophia Commons books page. Texts are not included.

language.description: de = give the original German text link first (for German speakers)

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, max 30)

query.description: Topic or title words, e.g. "karma", "bees", "Philosophy of Freedom", "Christmas"

year.description: Only lectures given in this year

name: find_steiner_works
title: Find Rudolf Steiner's works
